# 卷帘门 | Rolling Gate

> 一个NeoForge模组，控制Minecraft技术选项
>
> A NeoForge mod that controls Minecraft technology options

[![Development Builds](https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/RollingGate/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/RollingGate/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![GitHub downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Anvil-Dev/RollingGate/total?label=Github%20downloads&logo=github)](https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/RollingGate/releases)

## 現有附加 | Existing Additional

*   Survival++ [\[GitHub\]](https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/SurvivalPlusPlus) [\[Modrinth\]](https://modrinth.com/mod/survival-plus-plus)
    * 控制遊戲的技術性選項
    * Game Technology Options Control
*   Server++ [\[GitHub\]](https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/ServerPlusPlus) [\[Modrinth\]](https://modrinth.com/mod/server-plus-plus)
    * 控制伺服器的技術性選項
    * Server Technology Options Control
*   BetterTab [\[GitHub\]](https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/BetterTab) [\[Modrinth\]](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-tab)
    * 在標籤列表中顯示mobcaps、TPS、MSPT和自訂行
    * Show mobcaps, TPS, MSPT and Custom line in tab list
*   SiliconeDolls [\[GitHub\]](https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/SiliconeDolls) [\[Modrinth\]](https://modrinth.com/mod/silicone-dolls)
    * 召喚假玩家並控制他們
    * Summon fake players and control them
*   AnvilCraft-Skyland [\[GitHub\]](https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft-Skyland) \[Modrinth\]
    * 生成空島並自由調整生成規則
    * Generate an skyland and freely adjust the generation rules

## 聲明 | Disclaimer

> 本模組僅支援 Minecraft 1.21+ ，暫無向更低版本相容的計畫。
>
> This mod only supports Minecraft 1.21+ and has no plans to be compatible with lower versions at the moment.
>
> 本模組程式碼基於 [LGPL-3.0](./LICENSE) 協議開源，其它資產基於 [CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0](./LICENSE_ASSETS) 發布，請遵守協議。
>
> This module code is open source based on the [LGPL-3.0](./LICENSE) protocol, while other assets are released based on
> the [CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0](./LICENSE_ASSETS) protocol. Please comply with the protocol.

## 快速開始 | Quick Start

1. 下載模組，放置到 `.minecraft/mods` 或 `.minecraft/versions/{version}/mods` 資料夾
2. 進入存檔，使用 `/rg` 命令顯示模組控制面板以調整規則的啟用狀態

## 配置 | Configuration

* 在 `configs/rolling-gate.json` 中修改預設配置，該配置將影響所有存檔
* 在存檔目錄中建立 `rolling-gate.json` 檔案以覆蓋預設配置
* 配置檔案格式為 JSON，範例如下：

```json5
{
  // string
  "rule1": "value",
  // int
  "rule2": 1,
  // double
  "rule3": 1.0,
  // boolean
  "rule4": true
}
```

## 命令 | Command

* `/rg` - 顯示模組控制面板
    * `reload` - 重新載入配置檔案
    * `category [category]` - 查看分組下的所有規則
    * `[rule] [value]` - 設定規則的值
    * `[rule]` - 查看規則詳細介紹
    * `default [rule] [value]` - 設定目前存檔的規則預設值

* `/rg` - Display mod control panel
    * `reload` - Reload configuration file
    * `category [category]` - View all rules under the group
    * `[rule] [value]` - Set the value of the rule
    * `[rule]` - View detailed information of rules
    * `default [rule] [value]` - Set default rules for the current save

## 規則 | Rules

| 規則         | 類型     | 預設值     | 允許值              | 描述         |
|------------|--------|---------|------------------|------------|
| `language` | String | `zh_cn` | `en_us`, `zh_cn` | 設定捲簾門的預設語言 |

| Rule       | Type   | Default Value | Allowed Value    | Description                              |
|------------|--------|---------------|------------------|------------------------------------------|
| `language` | String | `zh_cn`       | `en_us`, `zh_cn` | Set the default language for RollingGate |

## 編寫附屬 | Write Additional

* 編寫一個類別新增規則
* Write a class addition rule

```java

@RGServerRules(value = "your_mod_id", languages = {"zh_cn", "en_us"})
public class YourModServerRules {
    @Rule(allowed = {"your_rule_value1", "your_rule_value2"}, categories = "your_rule_category")
    public static String yourRule = "your_rule_value1";
}
```
